brief.name: Chief of Staff
brief.summary: A meeting assistant that remembers the meeting so you make the call.
brief.intended_appearance: A blue wax seal with evenly shaded gold lettering and C/check, restrained reflections and muted finish; green ribbons.

concept.metaphor: A serif C whose opening holds a check stroke; Chief of Staff remembers the meeting, you make the call.
concept.treatment: wax seal with ring legend and crossed ribbons

state.intended_appearance: A blue wax seal with evenly shaded gold lettering and C/check, restrained reflections and muted finish; green ribbons.

criteria.true: Gloss, reflection strength, highlight contrast and edge roundness suit the stated finish, whether restrained or glossy.
criteria.false: The visible finish contradicts the stated direction, even if it is competently executed in another style.
